label: Letter: the Narrow Sea silver

label: Diary, day 40
text: A page torn from a diary. "Day 40. The King no longer eats. He sits at the long table and talks to the empty chairs. I think the chairs answer."

label: The portraits
text: A note. "The portraits were painted from life. The painter did not leave the room afterwards."

label: Letter: the chancellor's seal
text: A folded letter, signed V. "My lord. The chancellor’s seal is mine. The king signs what I set before him and sees nothing. I have hidden six pieces of the key in six hands across the Eastern Lands, so that only your servants will find them and open the door."

label: Not Yours
text: Carved with a fine hand: Everything here that shines is not yours. Most of it is not even gold.

label: Hedge warning
text: Chalked on the wall: The hedge maze is the easy part. Do not get cocky.

label: Which Left
text: A neat note: If you are reading this, you are lost. So was I. Turn left. No, the other left.

label: There is a shortcut here
text: Scratched small: There is a shortcut here. I walked into the wall to find it, and I was right. Try the walls that look a shade off.

label: The slug is not slow
text: Written in charcoal: The slug is not slow. The slug is patient. There is a difference.

label: Do Not Feed
text: A child's drawing of a worm, with a sign: DO NOT FEED. Underneath, someone has added: TOO LATE.

label: Spent Keys
text: Carved deep: A KEY IS USED UP IN THE LOCK. SAVE THEM FOR THE GOOD DOORS.

label: Gem doors
text: Chalked: Gem doors are worth the trouble. The treasure behind them is better than anything you can buy.

label: Signs Mean It
text: Scratched: The signs mean what they say. I have stood under one and watched a worm go by the other way.

label: LOST: one lantern
text: A note pinned to the wall: LOST: one lantern, brass, very dear to me. If found, please do not return it, I am never going back there.

label: Four Towns
text: Chalked: Four towns is a good walk. Eight towns is a good life.

label: Warm Walls
text: Scratched into the sandstone: The walls here are warm at noon, and I do not know why. There is no noon.

label: I came for the treasure
text: Scribbled: I came for the treasure and stayed for the soup. Ask in the towns.

label: Press the Wall
text: Scratched: Dead ends are not always dead. Press on the wall at the end, and press on the wall before it.

label: The ponds are shallow
text: Written small: The ponds are shallow and the fish are not real. Do not ask me how I know.

label: Tile Count
text: Scratched into the grout: Eleven thousand tiles and not one of them is a door.

label: Moving Walls
text: A note: Whoever keeps moving the walls, please stop.

label: Gold Key, Gold Door
text: Carved: I found a gold key in a vault and a gold door two hours later. I have never been so happy.

label: The warden at the top is not as...
text: Chalked: The warden at the top is not as clever as he looks. He is bigger than he looks, though.

label: Maze Dwellers
text: Scratched: There are people living in the maze who have never seen the sky. They are very polite about it.

label: The old Warden
text: A scrap of cloth nailed up: The Hollowed Warden was a gardener once. We do not talk about the hedge.

label: Rest in the safe places
text: Written in a neat hand: Rest in the safe places. Fight in the dangerous ones. Never confuse the two.

label: Door and key rule
text: Scratched: Blue door, blue key. Red door, red key. Gem door, gem. Nobody has ever been this organised before.

label: Counting Steps
text: Chalked: I counted the steps from the start to the top. Then the maze changed my mind.

label: Many Middles
text: Carved: Every maze has a middle. This one has several, and none of them is the middle.

label: If the lamp goes out, stand still
text: A note: If the lamp goes out, stand still. If the lamp goes out and something breathes, run.

label: Spider Warning
text: Scratched: The spiders are the worst. They are also, I am told, delicious. I have not tested this.

label: Atriums are full of trees and quiet
text: Chalked: Atriums are full of trees and quiet. Quiet is good. Trees are better. Ponds are best.

label: Child at the Signs
text: A child's writing: MY MOTHER SAYS NOT TO GO PAST THE SIGNS. I AM ON THE SAFE SIDE. I CAN SEE THE SIGN FROM HERE.

label: Gilded Quarter
text: Carved by a careful hand: The Gilded Quarter is the richest and the most dangerous. They are the same thing.

label: Large Night Visitor
text: Scratched: Something large went past here in the night, and it did not say good morning.

label: Quiet Blue Quarter
text: Chalked: The Blue Quarter is quiet. Too quiet. I have gone back.

label: To whoever finds my gem: it...
text: A note: To whoever finds my gem: it was a gift. Please do not use it on a door. Marry someone with it.

label: The mosaic was beautiful once
text: Written small: The mosaic was beautiful once. Then the dark came and the tiles began to fall.

label: Twelve tasks
text: Scratched: There are twelve people in the maze who will give you a task. I have done two. I am very tired.

label: Every shop is better than the last
text: Chalked: Every shop is better than the last, but the last is dearer. Choose wisely.

label: The hollow slugs came up through...
text: Carved: The hollow slugs came up through the floor at the same time as the dark. Make of that what you will.

label: Do not trust a corridor that...
text: A note: Do not trust a corridor that is too straight. Nobody built one.

label: Missing Ladder
text: Scratched: The gilders left in a hurry and took the ladder. Why the ladder?

label: The hedge here is older than...
text: Scratched: The hedge here is older than the maze. Trust the hedge.

label: Blue Lamps
text: Chalked in pale blue: The blue lamps do not flicker. Be wary of anything that does not flicker.

label: Slug warning
text: Chalked: Slow here. The slug on the left wall is faster than it looks.

label: There is a way round
text: Carved: There is a way round, and it is the long way, and it is worth it.

label: Do not feed
text: A child's drawing of a worm, with a sign: DO NOT FEED. Underneath, someone has added: TOO LATE.

label: Tobin the hedge-clipper sat down...
text: Tobin the hedge-clipper sat down here to rest in the spring. He meant to finish the south row after supper. The hedge finished first.

label: A faded ribbon is tied to the branch
text: A faded ribbon is tied to the branch. Every year someone ties a new one beside it. Nobody in Hedgefoot will say whose they are.

label: We stacked the crates here...
text: We stacked the crates here to hold the thorns back. The thorns did not mind the crates. Go back the way you came.

label: Two hundred
text: Carved into the wall: Two hundred and eleven scratches, in rows of five. Then the scratches stop, and one clean line runs across all of them.

label: The mason left his tools
text: The mason left his tools and his lunch on the ledge. The lunch is long gone to dust. Nothing has been taken, and nothing has been finished.

label: A bedroll, a cold fire, a diary
text: A bedroll, a cold fire, a diary. The last page says: I can hear the walls humming the song my mother used to sing. I am going to listen a little closer.

label: Honey for the lamp
text: Honey for the lamp and wax for the wick. Mind the floor here. It is sweet, and it is not always honey.

label: Even the guards of the comb grow old
text: Even the guards of the comb grow old. This one stood so long the wax grew over his boots. He has not been relieved.

label: It is quiet here
text: It is quiet here. The cells are shut and warm. Whatever sleeps in them has not been told it is time.

label: I came for one perfect shell
text: I came for one perfect shell. This is the fortieth, and it is still not perfect. I will stay a little longer.

label: The tide has not come here in...
text: The tide has not come here in a hundred years, yet the floor is always damp. Leave a coin or leave a word. Do not leave nothing.

label: I hid my pearls under the third tile
text: I hid my pearls under the third tile. Whoever you are, the third tile is loose and the pearls are paste. I knew you would look.

label: We took turns at the lamp
text: Scratched: We took turns at the lamp. Then there was only one of us to take a turn.

label: The left way is shorter|The right way is kinder
text: Chalked: The left way is shorter. The right way is kinder.

label: If you find my boot, keep it
text: A scrap of cloth: If you find my boot, keep it. I will not be needing the other.

label: Water here, three days behind me
text: Carved: Water here, three days behind me. Do not drink the second pool.

label: I heard footsteps behind me...
text: Scratched: I heard footsteps behind me for an hour. They stopped when I stopped. They are still there.

label: Rested here
text: Chalked: Rested here. Nothing came. I mean to say so in the towns, and nobody will believe me.

label: Forty turns
text: Written small: Counted forty turns since the last sign. Turned back at forty-one.

label: Dear Mara, I have found the middle
text: Scratched: Dear Mara, I have found the middle. It is smaller than we thought.

label: The wall is warm on this side
text: Chalked: The wall is warm on this side. I did not look at the other side.

label: Someone has been here before me
text: Carved: Someone has been here before me and left the lamp lit. I thank them. I do not see them.

label: Sorry about the mess
text: A note, pinned: Sorry about the mess. I was in a hurry to leave.

label: Good ground for a camp
text: Scratched: Good ground for a camp, if you like the sound of the dripping. I have stopped hearing it.

label: Brother, if you read this, go home
text: Chalked: Brother, if you read this, go home. I mean it kindly.

label: The roots push the stones out...
text: Carved: The roots push the stones out every spring. By autumn the maze is a little different.

label: Quiet
text: Scratched: Quiet. Too quiet for the Hollow. I went the other way.

label: I was here and it was fine
text: A child's hand: I WAS HERE AND IT WAS FINE.

label: Two ways out
text: Chalked: Two ways out. I took the one that did not smell of honey.

label: A gold coin under the loose stone
text: Scratched: A gold coin under the loose stone. I put it back. It looked at me.

label: Turn back, or at least turn...
text: Written in charcoal: Turn back, or at least turn on the lamp.

label: Lost but sure
text: Carved: I do not know where I am, but I have never been so sure of the way.

label: The hedge grew a hand's width
text: Scratched: The hedge grew a hand's width while I wrote this.

label: Shells and candle
text: Chalked: Shells under the lamp, a candle in the dust. Somebody lived here, and not so long ago.

label: The treasure is not here
text: A note: The treasure is not here. I looked. Do not look again.

label: The pearls in the wall are real
text: Scratched: The pearls in the wall are real. The wall wants them back.

label: I buried my sword here
text: Chalked: I buried my sword here. The maze has taken enough of it already.

label: My name is Pell
text: Carved: My name is Pell. I was a tinker. If you find the cart, it is yours.

label: The air changes here
text: Scratched: The air changes here, a little sweeter, a little colder. Go slowly.

label: Stopped here to mend my boot
text: Chalked: Stopped here to mend my boot. Lost an hour. Lost the way. Found this note instead.

label: Dead end
text: Written small: The dead end is not the end. Nor is it the way.

label: One more turn
text: Scratched: One more turn, I said. One more turn.

label: Ate my last biscuit at this corner
text: Chalked: Ate my last biscuit at this corner. It was a good biscuit. I mean to mention it to the baker.

label: The crystals hum when you are afraid
text: Scratched: The crystals hum when you are afraid. I have been humming back for an hour.

label: Mason's Ward
text: Carved: Here ends the Mason's Ward, and here begins the part nobody mapped.

label: Day nine
text: A torn page: Day nine. The lantern oil is low and the walls are not. I am thinking of building a door.

label: If a wasp asks, I was never here
text: Chalked: If a wasp asks, I was never here.

label: Left a loaf for whoever follows
text: Scratched: Left a loaf for whoever follows. Left it on the high ledge, for the rats are tall here.

label: Measured corridor
text: Written small: I measured the corridor with my arms. It is longer going back.

label: For Anselm
text: Carved: For Anselm, who said the hedge would never grow this high. It has. Come and look.

label: Moss rule
text: Chalked in green: Moss on the north side. Moss on every side. Useless as a compass.

label: Warm honey
text: Scratched: The honey on the wall is warm. Please do not lick the honey.

label: Whoever finds this
text: A scrap of cloth: Whoever finds this, tell my wife I got as far as the shells.

label: A good place to cry
text: Chalked: A good place to cry, and I have done so. Thank you, corner.

label: There is a draught from the wall
text: Scratched: There is a draught from the wall. There is no door. There is a draught.

label: Eleven steps from here to the lamp
text: Carved: Eleven steps from here to the lamp, and every one of them uphill. I do not know how.

label: The glowing mushrooms are not food
text: Written in charcoal: The glowing mushrooms are not food. I have been sick twice to be sure.

label: Mildred's corner
text: Chalked: I named this corner Mildred. She has been a good listener.

label: Someone sang here once
text: Scratched: Someone sang here once. The walls still know the tune.

label: Wrong turn
text: A note: Lost two days to a wrong turn, found a spoon. A fair trade.

label: Do not trust a corridor that...
text: Chalked: Do not trust a corridor that is straight for more than thirty paces.

label: In the year of the second flood...
text: Carved: In the year of the second flood the pearls came up through the floor. Not all of them went back.

label: My candle burned down here
text: Scratched: My candle burned down here. I sat in the dark and counted to a thousand. Then I counted again.

label: Rain draught
text: Chalked: The dead end has a draught that smells of rain. I would go back to the rain.

label: I left my map here
text: Written small: I left my map here, with the wrong turns marked. You are welcome.

label: Borrowed lamp
text: Scratched: The lamp is not mine. I lit it anyway. It seemed rude not to.

label: My dad says the way out is up|We went down
text: A child's hand: MY DAD SAYS THE WAY OUT IS UP. WE WENT DOWN.

label: Nine hundred paces from the arch
text: Carved: Nine hundred paces from the arch and the arch was not worth it.

label: A stone fell behind me
text: Chalked: A stone fell behind me and the corridor shut. I opened it again with a spoon. Do not ask.

label: There are no bees here now
text: Scratched: There are no bees here now. There is only the sound of them.

label: I was brave until the third corridor
text: Written in charcoal: I was brave until the third corridor.

label: Rest your feet
text: Chalked: Rest your feet. Whatever comes next will want them.

label: Keeper's Cache
text: Carved under the owl: It keeps what the dark gives it. Take a little, and leave the rest. It counts.

label: Cold Camp Diary
text: Day nineteen. The Dry Ward goes round in circles. I have decided it is the corridors that are wrong and not me. If you read this, I went left.

label: Dunewell Founding
text: DUNEWELL. Founded beside a well. The well turned out to be a rumour. We kept the name out of stubbornness.

label: The Lamplighter
text: Tuck lit forty lamps here, one a night. She lit the last one, put down her ladder and went home. The statue is her. The lamp is still lit. Do not blow it out.

label: The Waiting Bench
text: Waiting for the Blue Door to open since spring. The bench is very good. The door is not.

label: Archive Notice
text: INKWELL COURT ARCHIVE. Everything is filed. Nothing can be found. Please return books to the shelf they fell from.

label: The Tile Counter
text: Counting the tiles. Lost count at 3,112. Starting again from the beginning. Please do not talk to me.

label: The Barricade
text: We stacked all this against the worm. The worm was behind us the whole time. It is a very good barricade.

label: The Mortar Mistake
text: Grout Court was to have a fine floor by Friday. The mason promised. It is still Friday here, and he is still kneeling in the corner.

label: Hunt Club Trophies
text: GILDMERE HUNT CLUB. Trophies so far: 3 antlers and 1 boot. Slugs: none. They know why.

label: Gilder's Hoard
text: A coin for the road and a chest for the patient. Not all that glitters is gold, but this is. Mind the lid.

label: The Little Shrine
text: Someone leaves a candle here every week. Nobody has ever seen them. Please leave it burning.

label: Cold Tiles
text: Scratched: The tiles are cold and the quiet is colder. I hummed to keep myself company.

label: Repeating Pattern
text: Chalked: The pattern repeats every nineteen paces. I know this because I have walked it nineteen times.

label: Mopping Gold
text: Chalked: A gold floor is a lovely thing until you have to mop it.

label: Blue Silence
text: A note: Blue lantern, blue door, blue silence. Pick any two to keep.

label: Swept Corridor
text: Carved: Somebody swept this corridor an hour ago. Nobody lives here.

label: Red Tiles
text: Carved: Follow the red tiles and you will arrive somewhere. Probably not where you hoped.

label: Guest Notice
text: A note, signed with a flourish: The Gilded Ward is open to guests. The guests are not open to us.

label: Wrong Map
text: A note: The mosaic shows a map of this place. It is wrong on purpose. Please do not ask me why.

label: One Coin
text: Written very small: I took one coin. I am still carrying it. It is very heavy.

label: Polite Warning
text: Scratched: The wealthy are polite to the end. The end is not far from here.

label: Dripping Sound
text: Chalked: I followed the sound of dripping for a day. It was my own water bottle.

label: A Sock
text: Scratched small: The Blue Quarter keeps its secrets in the corners. I found one. It was a sock.

label: Nice Dead End
text: Scratched: I came all this way for a dead end. It is a nice one, I will say that.

label: Crooked Tile
text: Scratched: I laid one tile crooked on day one. Nobody has noticed. I think about it daily.

label: Turn Back
text: Chalked: Turn back. There is nothing here but this note, and I wrote it myself.

label: Quiet Seat
text: Scratched small: A good place to sit. Nobody has found me yet.

label: Not a Door
text: Carved: This wall is not a door. I checked it for an hour.

label: Dead End Warning
text: Chalked: If you have read this, the dead end got you too.

label: Wrong Turn
text: Scratched: Left at the last crossing was right. I did not.

label: Humming Tiles
text: Chalked: If the tiles hum, step back. If they sing, run.

label: Sand Complaint
text: Chalked: Sand in my boots, sand in my bread, sand in the maze. I regret all three.

label: Rumour of a Well
text: Carved neatly: Every ward has a well. This one has the rumour of one.

label: Pillar Count
text: Scratched: Count the pillars on your left. Mine came to eleven. Yours will not.

label: Old Dust
text: Chalked: The dust here is older than the dark. Do not sneeze.

label: Moving Corridors
text: A note weighed down with a pebble: Back the way I came, and the way I came has moved.

label: A brass plate at the foot of...
text: A brass plate at the foot of the statues: The Four Saints of the Garden. Knight, smith, lady, child. They stood on the lawn for three hundred years and the pond has had them for ten.

label: The archivist moved the abbey...
text: The archivist moved the abbey library down here when the pond began to rise. She said books should be kept where they cannot burn. She did not say what else the water would keep.

label: A diver's slate: Hest went...
text: A diver's slate: Hest went in for the pearls with one helm between two of us. I held the rope. The rope held. I do not know about the rest. The chest by my knee is his share.

label: A fisher's note: I hung three...
text: A fisher's note: I hung three lanterns here so that nobody would be lost in the dark. If you can see this one, you are not lost yet. Follow the glow back to the wide room.

label: A dead end
text: Scratched small: A dead end. I came all this way for a dead end.

label: Turn back
text: Chalked: Turn back. The reeds are thicker beyond, and there is no beyond.

label: Two lefts, one right, and you...
text: Written in oil: Two lefts, one right, and you are here. Two rights, one left, and you are not.

label: Somebody sat here a long time
text: Scratched: Somebody sat here a long time. The weed on the floor is flattened in the shape of a person.

label: I counted forty breaths of air...
text: Carved: I counted forty breaths of air on this side of the maze. Spend them on the middle, not on the corners.

label: A fisher's mark
text: A fisher's mark, three lines and a hook: Good eels in the weed here. Bad eels in the weed next door.

label: My brother says the walls are...
text: Chalked: My brother says the walls are the same green as the water. They are not. The water is greener.

label: The steps up
text: Carved in the wall at the crossing: THE STEPS UP, 22 squares on, by the east passage. THE WARDEN, 42 squares on, by the north passage. The water does not care which you choose.

label: A lantern-maker's mark
text: A lantern-maker's mark and two lines of chalk: Up and out is 46 squares, west first. The Warden sleeps 24 squares off, north first. Someone has scratched out a third line here, and then written it again.

label: Dry land, 56 squares away, start...
text: Painted on the stone in fading white: Dry land, 56 squares away, start north. The big room with the Warden in it, 68 squares away, start west. Trust the arrows. Do not trust the weed.

label: If you are tired
text: Scratched with a spoon handle: If you are tired, the steps up are 86 squares, north. If you are brave, the Warden is 60 squares, north. Count your breaths at every crossing.

label: A ferryman's tally
text: A ferryman's tally, cut deep: Air above, 42, leave south. Trouble below, 30, leave north. The numbers are squares. The fish keep to the left. Do as they do.

label: Chiselled in neat capitals:...
text: Chiselled in neat capitals: STAIRS 46 (WEST). WARDEN 30 (EAST). KEEP TO THE MIDDLE OF THE PASSAGE. Do not stop here. Do not stop anywhere that has a sign.

label: I counted it twice
text: Written in lamp oil on a wet beam: I counted it twice. 97 squares to the stairs, going east. 52 squares to the Warden, going east. The ink is the pond's. It will not last, so read it now.

label: A sailor's rhyme
text: A sailor's rhyme, scratched small: 59 to the light, 14 to the dark. The light lies south from here, the dark lies south. Someone has underlined the word nearest, twice.

label: Cast in the abbey foundry
text: Scratched under the bell frame: Cast in the abbey foundry, blessed by seven monks. The water has blessed it since, and the bell has been very quiet about its feelings.

label: A ticket stub stuck to the hull:...
text: A ticket stub stuck to the hull: One crossing, any dawn. Paid in full. Not refundable, not returnable, not afloat.

label: Small offerings crowd the niche:...
text: Small offerings crowd the niche: a button, a pearl, a child's tooth. The saint has refused none of them.

label: A second card tucked into...
text: A second card tucked into the frame: Whoever stands in front of this glass sees the lamps lit and the door open. Whoever stands beside it sees only water. Stand beside it.

label: Hest, if you come back for your...
text: Scratched on a tin cup: Hest, if you come back for your share, the lantern is still lit. I did not wait long. I waited as long as the oil lasted.

label: Count the pearls twice
text: Chalked on the rock: Count the pearls twice. The clams count them too, and they have never once lost count.

label: Weights stacked beside the scales
text: Weights stacked beside the scales, each stamped with a name. The smallest says Kindness. The largest says Gold. They weigh exactly the same.

label: A ledger page weighed down with...
text: A ledger page weighed down with a keg: Forty crates in, thirty nine out. The fortieth is under here somewhere. Do not ask what is in it.

label: A fisherman's knot tied round...
text: A fisherman's knot tied round the lamp hook: For luck, and for finding the way back.

label: Small stones piled at the foot...
text: Small stones piled at the foot of the tall slab, one for each visitor who read the letters aloud. There are only three. The rest read them quietly.

label: Notices
text: Pinned under the notice: the names of divers who read this and went on. The list is long and the ink is fresh.
